resources.string: Explore animal signs, elements and traditional cycle readings. Select an animal for its details.
Look up a solar birth date
Signs change at Vietnamese lunar New Year, UTC+7. A birth before Tết can belong to the previous lunar year.
Cultural descriptions for reflection. Ox and Rabbit are adapted to Vietnamese Buffalo and Cat. This source is not used for year or element calculations.
Two members do not form a complete three-branch configuration. Birth-year relationships do not determine real relationships.

Day: civil date · Week: Mon–Sun · Month/year: Vietnamese lunar periods, leap months separate.

A week aggregates its actual dates; no weekly pillar is invented.
Lịch Việt writes these reflections from branch relationships. They are not dated forecasts written by the source author, and do not predict definite events.

Three offline tools with sources: elements and nạp âm, hour pillars, and 24 Mountains / Eight Houses.
Compare the nạp âm elements of two lunar birth years. This is an element relationship, not a marriage compatibility score.
Choose two birth dates to resolve signs around lunar New Year.
Generation: Wood → Fire → Earth → Metal → Water → Wood.\nControl: Wood → Earth → Water → Fire → Metal → Wood.
Civil time at UTC+7. Zi is split into 00–01 and 23–24 to expose the day boundary. Intervals include the start and exclude the end.
The 23:00 rule needs a day beyond the supported range. Select midnight or an earlier date.
0° = North, 90° = East; clockwise. Enter a value from 0 to 360. This is a manually entered bearing, not a sensor compass.
Enter a valid bearing from 0 to 360.
Eight Houses uses the sitting bearing (180° opposite the facing). This is the house trigram, not a birth-year gua. Doors, floors and site layout are not analysed.
The standard needle divides 24 mountains into 15° sectors, with Zi at 0°. A lower boundary belongs to the new sector. Use one north reference; magnetic declination is not adjusted.
Sheng Qi, Tian Yi and other names are historical terms, not health, lifespan or wealth conclusions. All eight directions are shown without numerical fortune scores.

string-array.name: zd_readings
string-array.item: Harmony or shared trine membership suggests a theme of connection. Use the cycle to reflect on collaboration.
Opposition suggests a theme of adjustment. Review unresolved differences and prepare alternatives.
The same branch suggests repetition. Revisit habits, keep what works and choose one thing to improve.
No highlighted harmony or opposition appears in this table. Base plans on practical progress and preparation.
This week contains both harmony/trine and opposition dates. Use the daily table to reflect on a flexible rhythm.

string-array.name: zd_work_readings
string-array.item: Choose a task to discuss and agree on clear responsibilities.
Review deadlines, requirements and assumptions before changing plans.
Finish work in progress and record what you have learned.
Separate time for collaboration from time for checking results.

string-array.name: zd_relationship_readings
string-array.item: Listen actively and state shared expectations.
Clarify possible misunderstandings and speak calmly.
Leave room for a different perspective on familiar situations.
Keep in touch consistently and respect differences.
Stay flexible with shared schedules and confirm important arrangements.

string-array.name: zd_source_scopes
string-array.item: A short summary of cultural symbolism. Adapting Ox/Rabbit to Buffalo/Cat is editorial. The source year table is not reused.
Documents the Vietnamese Buffalo and Cat animal names.
Uses six harmony pairs, four trine groups and six oppositions. Cycle reflections are written by Lịch Việt, not dated forecasts from the classic.
Uses the sixty-cycle, thirty nạp âm pairs and generation/control cycles. Nạp âm differs from stem and branch elements.
Tables 2–5 give stem–branch order, double-hours, month stems and hour stems. The 00:00/23:00 rollover convention is selected separately.
Uses the standard needle and standard elements for 24 Mountains, and the three-line changes of Đại Du Niên. The base is the sitting house trigram, not a birth gua.
The six auspicious deities are Qing Long, Ming Tang, Jin Gui, Tian De, Yu Tang and Si Ming. Qing Long starts from the day branch, then advances through twelve hours.
